fields.name: Timeout
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D10600 creates the component (bg3.exe+0x2D12320) next to the deferred ending state and writes 'longest fade duration + 1.0'; bg3.exe+0x2D10A20 subtracts the frame delta (GameTime +8) each frame and, at <= 0, removes the component and emits the fade-in events anyway.

fields.name: Users
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D10A20 inserts 4-byte user ids (bg3.exe+0xBDCF90 on component + 8) reported as faded in for the fade of that name, and finishes when the key count (+0x34) reaches the user count of the deferred ending state (+0x4C). Constructor zeroes 0x08..0x38 as a set.

second_pass: Offsets and widths are from Windows code (bg3.exe+0x2D10600 writes the timeout, bg3.exe+0x2D10A20 inserts 4-byte user ids into the set at +8); 10 live instances show the float timeout (1.0, 7.0) at +0 and an empty set after it.
